claims.claim: GetByConnectorName loads options_json from cdc_system.connection_registry, BuildStoredConfigBaseline filters !IsKeepOrMaskedSecret(v) && !IsMaskedURI(v) when merging liveCfg, ValidateNoMaskedSecrets rejects any unresolved masked secret or URI before Kafka Connect calls, and UpdateSystemConnectorConfigCommand uses PreResolved to avoid duplicate GetConfig calls.

DiscoverPostgresTablesPost and resolveMongoIntrospectionURI enforce host-bound secret resolution: stored connector credentials are only resolved when host/port/username (for Postgres) or SameURIHostAuthority (for MongoDB URI) matches the connector's stored configuration.

debezium_connector_secrets.go handles comma-separated multi-URI fs.uris lists, restores username-only URIs (len(curParts) == 1) without appending :***, applies IsMaskedURI across all config keys in MergeConnectorConfigPreservingSecrets, and extractCredentialsAsOptions uses u.User.Username() and u.User.Password().

SourceConnectors.tsx normalizes empty or masked (* / •) password inputs to KEEP_SECRET_SENTINEL in both edit and recover modes, and passes connector_name to checkHook.check and pgCheckHook.check when editorMode is edit or recover.

ListSourcesHandler.Handle and GetSourceHandler.Handle in list_sources.go and SourcesHandler.Create in sources_handler.go mask URI userinfo in ServerAddress before returning Source records to API callers.
